Name: Turn fish roe into a tasty lucky pouch
Author: Tsuki0v0
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]           In the game, I have always used the original fish seed, so I plan to draw a replacement texture of the fish seed. At first, I wanted to draw it into sushi, but I thought that the dyeing system in the game would be a disaster, so I thought of my favorite fish seed lucky bag and replaced the fish seed with my favorite fish seed lucky bag.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]          Because it is a single beautification special module, it seems to be too much, so I will put png this time! Please download and merge into springobjects! .[/color]


           游戏内用的一直是原版鱼籽的样子，所以打算画一个鱼籽的替换，一开始是想画成寿司的样子但是想到了游戏内的染色系统应该会很特别难看，所以想到了很爱吃的鱼籽福袋就把鱼籽替换成的爱吃的鱼籽福袋！因为是单个美化专门制作份模组好像太过火了，所以这次就放的png！请下载后合并到springobjects！
